sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: Six unauthorised persons boarded the tanker underway and entered the engine room. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the perpetrators escaped with the stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to VTIS. All crew members reported safe.
